annotations.title: Check a job link someone pastes

description: Check a job link someone pastes. For "is this job real?", "what does this one pay?" with a link. Reads the advert from the employer's job board (Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Ashby and most career pages) and gives the title, company, place, pay, when it was posted, whether it looks like a live, open job, visa sponsorship and a short summary. LinkedIn, Indeed and Glassdoor pages can't be read; the advert text can be pasted into the CV match instead.

url.description: The full link to the job advert.
